employer_specifics: Walter (gowalter.co) is a remote staffing agency 'powered by We Work Remotely' that places Latin American and Philippine talent with (mainly North American) companies, charging a one-time placement fee with a 12-month replacement guarantee.

The role brief: build production-grade generative-AI applications end to end (Node.js/Python backend, React-style frontend, cloud deploy), with 'appropriate safeguards and monitoring' around LLM integration and optimisation of prompt flows — 'real products, not just prototypes'.

The five screening questions are entirely about working with Claude Code (context management in a monorepo, repo setup, API vs CLI vs MCP choice, % of code generated) — the end client is clearly a Claude-Code-centric shop.
Requires ideally 5+ years full-stack engineering and 'demonstrated experience shipping multiple production-grade products or platforms'.
verify.red_flags: Scout report misattributed the employer: the ad is branded Toptal on WWR but the application goes to Walter, an offshore/nearshore staffing agency owned by WWR whose pitch is 'save up to 80% compared to North American salaries' — pay will be priced for LatAm/Philippines, far below the £500/day floor. Eligible countries on the real ATS are CA/US/BR/CO/AR/MX only; UK not eligible. End client unnamed. No rate stated. Posted 24 Jul (not fresh), closes 23 Aug. Mandatory CV upload plus five required Claude Code screening essays. Toptal's name adds nothing — this is not Toptal's network or a Toptal vetting pipeline.
verify.decision_reason: Misreported so badly the fit collapses: the real poster is Walter, a WWR-owned nearshore staffing agency recruiting for an unnamed client at LatAm/Philippines cost levels; UK is not among the eligible countries on the Workable posting; no rate stated and the agency's whole model is 80% salary savings versus North American pay, so the £500/day contract floor is unreachable. Not worth a CV upload and five essay answers three days before close.
